text:
Keisha M: Heads up 

SolarWave renewal due next week. They want to reduce 200 seats -> 150 and split payment into two POs (engineering and ops). Need proration and vendor code.
Omar H: Got it. Current term ends 2026-07-01. They want the renewal to start 2026-08-01 (align with project). Asked for 11-month term.
Renee D: Finance: 11-month term ok, but we'll issue a prorated invoice and credit memo for the one-month gap. Need both PO numbers, vendor code, and billing email.
Keisha M: Looping in procurement 

@solarwave-procurement please provide PO-E (eng) and PO-O (ops) + vendor code and billing contact.
billing-bot: Drafting amendment envelope (eSign) via DocuSign. Link: https://docusign.example.com/x/sol-789
Keisha M: Customer replied: "PO-E: SW-ENG-2102, PO-O: SW-OPS-2103, billing@solarwave.io, prefer Net45"
Renee D: Net45 accepted. Finance note: if PO-O delays >6 business days, we will issue partial invoice for PO-E and hold rest pending receipt.
Omar H: Product confirms seat reduction ok, will need 3 business days to reassign seats and rerun the enablement invites.
Keisha M: Action list: 1) upload PO-E and PO-O to SF 2) send DocuSign to sign amendment 3) finance to prepare prorated invoice + credit 4) enablement schedule transfer call.
Keisha M: Update 

PO-E uploaded. PO-O pending corporate approval. Sent DocuSign link.
Renee D: Received PO-E. Preparing partial invoice for 75 seats (covering PO-E) and will hold final reconciliation until PO-O arrives and amendment signed.
Keisha M: Setting renewal risk to "medium" in SF until both POs + signed amendment are complete. Will update thread when PO-O arrives or DocuSign completes. :white_check_mark:
